summary: Nu-Med Plus, Inc. (issuer) filed an 8-K reporting a Share Exchange Agreement to acquire 100% of Avid Gold Ltd. Consideration is 4,500,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock to Avid Gold shareholders pro-rata plus assumption of a $100,000 promissory note. No per-share price, premium, or implied value is stated. Closing is subject to customary conditions with a required date of July 8, 2026, extendable by mutual consent. The board has not disclosed a recommendation or advisor. The transaction is structured as a reverse triangular merger. Watch for regulatory or shareholder approvals; if delayed, risk-arb focuses on termination provisions including a 30-day cure period and ability to close within 12 months.
